entities.name: ZDR

evidence.quote: ZDR.

evidence.quote: So ZDR is always best, of course.

evidence.quote: So we have seen in pilots that people claim they have ZDR.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: If you say ZDR, do ZDR.

entities.name: 企业就绪 (Enterprise Ready)
entities.how_described: 本集的核心主线：创业公司和买方对企业就绪的理解相差太远，40% 死于有效性，其余大量死在安全、可靠性、法务上。

evidence.quote: So I want to talk about what Enterprise Ready actually means from the inside because we have a lot of startups that tell me what Enterprise Ready means and then we go through all of our requirements and then we have a very different idea of what Enterprise Ready actually means.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: RBAC
entities.how_described: 本集要求产品的权限组能绑定到 RBAC，避免一刀切为所有人开启功能，且可通过 API 配置。

evidence.quote: Skim tied RBAC.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 权限 (entitlements)
entities.how_described: 本集指出大企业里大量员工权限过多或不足，entitlements 需要一个新范式，且要在智能体到来之前修好。

evidence.quote: Number one, entitlements.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Entitlements need a new paradigm.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The entitlements model and how it works and how it's managed, all of that breaks down when you think about agents and how quickly you want agents to work and what you want them to work on and their ability to exercise judgment.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So I strongly recommend that everybody fix their entitlements if they are not working really well now because this is something that if you think about the problems that you run into when things go rogue, processes go rogue, people go rogue, agents are gonna like 100x that problem.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Auth, entitlements, governance, audit logging, et cetera.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 遗留架构 (legacy architecture)
entities.how_described: 本集论点：AI 模型和产品修不好你的遗留架构，实现 AI 原生的 60% 是数据卫生、干净架构、集成、变更管理这些枯燥工作。

evidence.quote: Maybe it's your legacy architecture, probably a lot of security and privacy issues, and a lot of change management.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: AI models and products today can't fix your legacy architecture.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: That gap between your legacy architecture and where you want to go might be so vast that you actually just decide, hey, maybe we need a separate ecosystem to do a lot of this work, figure out what does work and what doesn't, and then kind of go from there.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 试点 (pilot)
entities.how_described: 本集说试点窗口期正在坍缩：从两年前的六个月缩到三个月、现在可能只给两周，且他们的试点都跑在生产数据上。

evidence.quote: So the other thing I want to point out at the very bottom of this slide is the pilot window collapsing.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And when I started, a lot of these pilot timelines that people were used to were like, oh, maybe we'll run a pilot for six months.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And anymore, it's like, maybe we can do this pilot for two weeks because it's just accelerated so rapidly.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We do weekly check-in calls during a pilot, and then we hear this over and over.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
